Command.label: 跳到最后一个图章
Command.tooltip: 页面跳转到最后一个图章所在的页面

Item.name: ScriptCode
Item.value: this.syncAnnotScan(); var annots = this.getAnnots(); // no need to sort var maxPage = -1; if (annots != null) { for (var i = 0; i < annots.length; i++) { if (annots[i].type == "Stamp") { if (annots[i].page > maxPage) { maxPage = annots[i].page; } } } } if (maxPage != -1) { this.pageNum = maxPage; }
